description: Fetch a Google Slides presentation's slide list — object id and page-element count per slide. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the slide list arrives via a follow-up message once the fetch completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Fetch a Google Slides presentation by id as a background job and return a summary of its slides: one row per slide carrying the object id needed to target it in a later structural edit, plus how many page elements (text boxes, images, shapes) that slide holds. The read that precedes editing a deck.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the presentation read; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to fetch a Google Slides presentation's slide summary.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the presentation id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_found: verify the presentation id. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
